# ChivarGo

> ChivarGo (ชีวาร์โก) is a healthy, low-impact island travel app for Koh Samui (Surat Thani) and Koh Sichang (Chonburi), Thailand. It is free for travellers on the web at https://chivargo.com/ and speaks Thai, English and Simplified Chinese.

Core idea: a point is only worth something if somebody had to check it. Green Points are issued only when a named local host approves a geotagged submission made inside a geofence on a given date. Trip Points are self-verified and are always shown separately.

## Features
- Green Points (host-verified) and Trip Points (self-verified)
- Quests and missions: beach clean-ups, waste drop-off, coral, local treasure, secret recipe, Trash Hero
- Adventure Map across the island
- Chivar Bot: AI concierge that recommends places from in-app data and says so when it has none
- Maps, getting-there directions, on-foot navigation, offline use
- SOS button and an island condition card
- Party: find travel mates, shared proof for a team, coastal watch parties, event mode
- Companions, 77 province mascots, capsule draws, backpack
- Passport, medals, seasons and leaderboard
- Local Picks: local restaurants, shops, markets, food courts
- Stay inquiries with terms stated by the operator
- Community feed and moderated reviews
- Travel journal, mini games, points wallet
- Hotels: a verifiable activity statement to attach to the sustainability/ESG report they already file (it measures no building and replaces no number)
- Host console for operators to verify activity

## Where
Two islands, and nowhere else. A coordinate is the island's own point, not a map frame.
- Koh Sichang (เกาะสีชัง), Chon Buri province (TH-20), 13.1599 N 100.8096 E. The pilot: the quests, the hosts and the verified activity are here. Twelve kilometres of sea west of Si Racha. About 6 x 2.8 km, walkable - the pier to the palace is 1.6 km.
- Koh Samui (เกาะสมุย), Surat Thani province (TH-84), 9.495 N 100.0 E.
The app also runs on three university campuses in Thailand: Kasetsart Si Racha, Kasetsart Bangkhen and Rajamangala Thanyaburi (RMUTT).

## Questions
- What is ChivarGo? A healthy, sustainable travel platform for exploring Koh Sichang and Koh Samui: collect points, complete quests, care for the island and connect with the community.
- Which devices can I use? The website, on a phone, tablet or computer. No app-store download is required.
- How do Green Points differ from Trip Points? Green Points require host approval. Trip Points follow travel activity rules. Balances and history are kept separate in Wallet.
- Do I always need a connection? Previously cached information is available offline. Some maps and directions need a connection. Evidence and rewards require server verification.
- How is personal data handled? Through the app's existing account controls. Location and camera access require device permission; see the privacy policy.
- How can a business join? Submit the partner application. The team reviews operator details and permissions before console access.
